title: Function coverage for Return Bus Character Overrun Count
purpose: Restore the removed duplicate as a unique valid diagnostics seed targeting the documented character-overrun counter subfunction.

messages.label: diagnostics request - return bus character overrun count

expected_behavior: A compliant server that supports Diagnostics should process function 0x08 subfunction 0x0012 and return the bus character overrun count, or issue an exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length field 0x0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
PDU order preserved as function 0x08, subfunction, data

issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid request; added as a safe unique analogue after duplicate removal, without reproducing any exact prior collision.
